post_dev_revision: After development smoke runs, scope_omission and function_not_checked were separated into evidence_completeness to clarify fair same-scope fresh comparison; expected labels were unchanged. B-fresh accounting and provenance records were clarified. All 16 cases are development-visible, not a final blinded test.

rules.labels_location: outer runner only; never inside bundle, candidate, before, or evidence
rules.validator_inputs: assess receives bundle, evidence, scanner and mode only; no case_id or expected verdict
rules.shared_inputs: within each trial A/B/C/C-no-binding receive independent deep copies of the identical evidence and the identical current candidate, scope and scanner
rules.layers: fresh contains only ten complete same-scope trials (four valid and six unacceptable candidates); two evidence-completeness faults and four delivery faults are separate. A/B on six evidence-fault cases are simplified aggregators of supplied results, not a fixed-scope CI rerun
rules.B_fresh: all cases also recollect scan/syntax/function evidence on the current candidate with the intended full scope, then assess mode B; use its own new-input oracle, not old delivered-evidence UNKNOWN labels, and show delivery cases separately
rules.repeat_interpretation: repeated runs measure execution stability; they are not independent case families or a larger statistical sample
rules.tool_claim: A/B are explicitly constructed comparisons, not claims about default commercial or open-source products

cases.oracle_fact: required environment read; preserved controlled behavior; unchanged original index
single-quoted spaced assignment and comments retain semantics after supported rewrite
function precedes module assignment; separate non-secret configuration remains unchanged
no synthetic token remains, but injected environment value is not used and missing environment does not fail closed
old synthetic token remains in fallback and absent environment silently falls back
old value remains in notes.txt within the same declared scope
notes.txt changed beyond the authorized assignment rewrite
valid candidate but delivered evidence omits notes.txt; this is incomplete evidence, not a bad patch
valid candidate but the controlled functional obligation was not executed
worktree is already environment-based while the selected index retains the old value; copy PASS must preserve index residual risk
candidate reads an unintended environment variable and fails the controlled positive functional probe
evidence was collected before a later behavior-breaking edit; current object binding differs
otherwise successful evidence comes from a separate frozen object; target candidate itself is valid
a scan check from a narrower declared scope is spliced into otherwise complete evidence
a scan check from another configuration digest is spliced into otherwise complete evidence

primary: incorrect PASS count on FAIL cases
incorrect PASS count on UNKNOWN evidence cases
secondary: one valid fixture: 3 independent fresh collect+assess samples per A/B/C with rotated order, mean/range/sample variance and mean C-B
excluded_claims: real-world secret detection precision or recall
population confidence intervals from 16 hand-designed cases
